title: 'We will get them': DILG goes after ‘TBS’ gang recruiting minors for crimes
summary: The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) said Monday it would go after the True Brown Style (TBS), a gang allegedly recruiting minors and grooming them into criminal activities.
